versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the model-prompt-generator skill.
- Generates professional English fashion photography prompts for AI image tools based on Chinese clothing descriptions.
- Prompts include model appearance, outfit coordination, scene lighting, and photography style.
- Supports user-specified details such as gender, age, ethnicity, scene, and pose.
- Ensures diversity, style consistency, and clarity in all generated prompts.
- Outputs a single, fluent, and vivid English prompt under 700 characters with no extra text.
